Iteration 2 should target: (A) westnile.ca.gov directly for weekly/cumulative 2024 WNV statistics; (B) CDPH news release NR24-27 context and date confirmation via a targeted search; (C) County-level August 2024 WNV reports for high-burden counties (Los Angeles, Sacramento, Kern, Fresno); (D) CDC WNV 2024 current season data page (distinct from historic data).
